decisions.recommended_path: Approve the current trilogy titles unless Lady D wants a stronger market-facing subtitle pass.
decisions.decision_needed: Final title and subtitle for each devotional and each companion journal.
decisions.done_when: Every KDP product title/subtitle is approved in writing and matches the cover/interior/title page.

decisions.recommended_path: Keep reference-only for the next proof, or approve one translation before adding full Scripture text.
decisions.decision_needed: References only, public-domain text, or licensed translation with required notice.
decisions.done_when: The copyright page carries the exact Bible translation and permission notice strategy.

decisions.recommended_path: Apply to samples first: fuller Scripture presence, warmer voice, simpler context lens, fused prompts.
decisions.decision_needed: Whether every day gets quoted Scripture text or a more compact reference-plus-reader-reflection format.
decisions.done_when: Sample pages are approved before trilogy-wide conversion.

decisions.recommended_path: Choose one coherent cover lane per volume, then regenerate final wraps only after page counts and paper type are locked.
decisions.decision_needed: Final cover concept, brightness, author name treatment, subtitle scale, paper type, and barcode plan.
decisions.done_when: The selected front cover and full-wrap proof pass thumbnail, spine, bleed, and barcode review.

decisions.recommended_path: Approve dedication, author welcome, bio, acknowledgments, and series page before final interior export.
decisions.done_when: No placeholders remain in copyright, dedication, bio, acknowledgments, or IDC imprint notes.

decisions.recommended_path: Launch Volume 1 and its companion journal first, then Volumes 2 and 3 after proof confidence.
decisions.decision_needed: Single-volume launch, trilogy launch, or staggered release calendar.
decisions.done_when: KDP metadata, prices, categories, and review copies match the selected release sequence.

decisions.recommended_path: Keep Sabbath as seventh-day/Saturday and obedience as response to grace across copy, metadata, and prompts.
decisions.decision_needed: Confirm no Sunday-as-Sabbath language and no performance-based salvation phrasing.
decisions.done_when: Final proof audit shows zero Sunday-as-Sabbath drift and no earning-love framing.

decisions.recommended_path: Use current KDP calculator and checkout for final proof/author-copy costs; use this sheet only for planning estimates.
decisions.decision_needed: How many proofs, who receives them, and what retail-price scenarios should be modeled.
decisions.done_when: Proof order quantity, shipping destination, retail prices, and author-copy path are documented.

source_manifest.freeze_boundary: These hashes describe the current review surfaces only. Final freeze happens after author decisions, Bible policy, final copyedit, cover lock, KDP Previewer, and physical proof.

release_boundary: This sheet is a decision and source-control gate, not a final upload approval.
Do not regenerate final wraps until trim, paper type, page counts, title/subtitle, and barcode strategy are locked.
Do not add full Bible quotation text until the Bible policy is approved and the copyright/permission notice is inserted.
Do not use public release language until KDP Previewer and physical proof review pass.
Keep Juan Damon testimony/autobiography separate unless a new scope is approved.
